theme: An open Wednesday with the girls in Florida.
greeting: Good morning, Dan. The day is nearly clear: one appointment for Claire mid-morning, then wide-open hours with the girls. A few trip loose ends are worth closing before the Disney weekend.

needsAttention.title: Disney tickets are still the open item
needsAttention.detail: The park days are Saturday and Sunday and tickets for all six are the last thing outstanding. Buy them and confirm whether your ticket type needs park reservations.

needsAttention.title: Reschedule the kids' passport appointment
needsAttention.detail: The passport appointment slipped past while you were traveling. Now that you're back, it needs a new date before the November book-by pressure builds.

needsAttention.title: Book the Maine Christmas SUV
needsAttention.detail: A full-size SUV out of Portland over Christmas week is the hardest rental in that market and sells out early. Book a refundable one this week and adjust dates later.
